items.title: Ruth Brown interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: an occasion in which we were going to Gulfport, Mississippi — Charles Brown, and Paul “Hucklebuck” Williams and myself.

ctx.x: The star pulls up in a Ferrari.

You could touch them. They were reachable. They were reachable. Most times we toured in buses, station wagons. And they when you got so-called to the top of the ladder which eventually happened in my case, there were those stars who did have the Cadillacs and whatnot, but you took it on your own, you chanced it, to go to the deep south with that kind of a vehicle. And I got arrested a couple of times. They locked the car up a couple of times, and they want to know how you could afford that even though — I had an…
